questions: Separate user-selected depth from discovery breadth and stopping criteria.
Evaluate authoritative evidence retrieval, access dates and deduplication without silently omitting requirements.
decision: Turn adaptive study into a bounded decision log: preserve user-selected depth, ask material questions, reuse dated evidence and stop when decisions are stable.
code_observations: studyctl normalizes explicit internal/external study choices and attaches evidence to planning. Its records distinguish questions, sources and synthesis.
The former plan repeated research as a future task even though the user now requests research in advance. Prepared reports should be inputs, not a reason to restart the same literature search.
implementation_steps: Add a compact reusable evidence record with material question, source/version/date, repository applicability, confidence and implementation consequence.
Distinguish verified source facts, observed repository behavior and proposed design. Store failed access attempts and unknowns explicitly rather than substituting a plausible fact.
Deduplicate shared external sources by stable ID while giving each task its own applicability analysis. Refresh only version-sensitive decisions or contradicted evidence.
Use a stopping condition: every high-impact question is answered or has a concrete implementation-time capability probe; no unresolved issue can silently change acceptance.
Preserve user-requested study breadth and the original source. Do not silently narrow a broad study to one blog or use an arbitrary source count as semantic proof.
proposed_acceptance_tests: A source with no date/version is flagged for refresh when it affects CLI behavior.
Two tasks sharing the same source retain different applicability notes without copying an entire article.
A contradictory provider document yields a probe requirement, not an invented resolution.
Known prepared reports are consumed without requiring another broad research phase.

alternatives.title: Study packet with broad prose findings
alternatives.tradeoff: Supports traceability, but can encourage repeated reading without explicit freshness disposition.

alternatives.title: Question-first evidence and selective refresh
alternatives.tradeoff: Keeps auditability with smaller repeated context and exposes unresolved material facts.

alternatives.title: Autonomous unlimited web exploration or source-count-only approval
alternatives.tradeoff: Expensive and may still miss the decisive compatibility question.

cost_model: Reuse verified source metadata and only reopen the source for a material uncertainty. Track sources retrieved, duplicated input bytes and decisions changed; do not equate more citations with higher quality.
unverified: No complete commercial book was available. This research uses the public AI Engineering excerpt and a public SRE chapter, explicitly labeled as such.
